empty.reason: A reading always shows exactly one card; there is no zero-item state.

single.reason: The screen is inherently single-item: one drawn card, shown by the typical scenarios.

many.reason: Only one card is ever read at a time; the three-card spread is a separate planned feature.

error.reason: A failed interpretation falls back to the written meaning, so the error state renders identically to the typical reading.

key-interaction.reason: Every action leaves the screen: Elegir otra carta navigates back, Compartir opens the OS share sheet, Descargar saves a file.

empty.reason: static landing with no data collection to be empty

single.reason: no list or collection rendered on this view

many.reason: no list or collection rendered on this view

loading.reason: server-rendered page, no async data fetch

edge.reason: fixed copy, no variable-length or optional fields

error.reason: no data fetch or failable operation on this view

key-interaction.reason: language toggle and navigation covered by LangToggle and HomeActions component scenarios
